public_state_mapping.principals: alice,bob,operator,admin map to native alice,bob,vault,pool in a separate role mapping; no implicit owner rights
public_state_mapping.balances: All twelve canonical rational cells are arbitrary nonnegative. The unused native debt cells are zero under ValidState.
public_state_mapping.supply: Derived separately by native total for each canonical asset; matches the required S=sum balances domain.
public_state_mapping.rates: Two independent arbitrary positive rationals, fixed by all operations.
public_state_mapping.capabilities: Any Finset of all canonical actor/right/target triples, including empty sets.
public_state_mapping.history: Arbitrary finite initial event list preserved exactly; successful single calls append one exact event, net appends one list-containing event. Theorems also tolerate initial histories outside the canonical well-formed subset.
public_state_mapping.raw_inputs: Arbitrary identifier Strings, all signed rational Number.exact values, Number.malformed envelope, and unsupported records. No production serializer refinement is claimed.

new_work: Generalized canonical financial operations and complete success/refusal contracts
Canonical invoke/gross-debit guards and raw input decoder
Finset administrator grants/revokes and complete public event history
Second-vault theorem instantiation and acceptance witnesses

native_control_boundary.reason: Native registered-operation, capability-ID/tombstone, and grouped atomic event semantics differ from the canonical suite; the added control wrappers have their own proofs. No refinement to those native control executors is claimed.

automation.assistance: AI target-specific theorem selection, helpers, decompositions, algebraic tactics and generic reuse application are assisted; models and canonical types are shared. All new proof helpers occur in the assisted replay chains.
automation.observations: Finite witnesses and mutants are admission diagnostics, not universal proofs or scored measurements. Automatic failures must remain separate from assisted success.

proof_checking.boundary: Separate invocations replay all new model/helper/target modules without source tactics, using the same Lean kernel. --fresh is not used; pinned imported library artifacts are trusted.
trust: Pinned imported Lean, mathlib and native dependency artifacts
Host execution and harness source/artifact selection and result parsing
not_claimed: Fresh checking of every imported library declaration

reuse.scope: Second instance of the frozen generic contract; no arbitrary new-protocol expressiveness claim. Phase effort and case allocations overlap and are not independent totals.

R3-COMPOSE-N4.domain: Every valid public state, every principal, and four independent signed rational amounts; vault A is fixed. AlgebraDomain computes intermediate balances from input effects and requires each amount, authority and gross debit check without assuming executor success.
R3-COMPOSE-N4.claims: ComposeCanonical gives complete success iff AlgebraDomain and exact first-refusal prefix behavior outside it. WorkflowClaims gives checked local contract composition, all prefixes, exact balances and receipts, nonnegativity, per-asset accounting, unchanged cash supply/rates/capabilities, shareA issuance minus burn, A surplus preservation, ordered four events, and the complete outside-footprint frame.
R3-COMPOSE-N4.wrappers: New canonical operation contracts and generic composition over actual native Core.execute. Native Composition.executeStep is not called.

R3-COMPOSE-N16.domain: Every valid public state, every principal, and sixteen independent signed rational amounts, with the A deposit/share-transfer/withdraw/cash-transfer pattern repeated four times. All guards use algebraically computed actual prefix balances.
R3-COMPOSE-N16.claims: Same complete success/refusal and modular WorkflowClaims as N4, with sixteen ordered events and independent amounts at every position. No coverage or timing is pooled with N4; both lengths share the canonical R3 adaptation allowance.
R3-COMPOSE-N16.wrappers: New composition contract and induction; actual financial execution and native local theorems reused.

R4-REFUSAL.domain: Every valid state and every list of four arbitrary RawCall records, including unsupported tags, invalid identifiers/numbers, signed amounts and administrative calls.
R4-REFUSAL.claims: RawExecutionSpec fixes every actual successful prefix state/event and exact first refusal. R4Canonical fixes the failure index and committed count, full preserved prefix state, complete-success count four, history prefix/count, and unchanged refused result for every appended suffix.
R4-REFUSAL.wrappers: New runRaw/RawStepSpec control wrapper around the native-backed single-call executor; no native registered-composition executor claim.

R5-REVOKE.domain: Every valid state, every financial call in its explicit success domain, and any member of its required capability set; all valid capabilities and all nonadmin/admin actors for general administration.
R5-REVOKE.claims: First call and admin revoke succeed; the same call then refuses UNAUTHORIZED unchanged without a repeat-call funds premise. Exact admin-only insert/erase, set idempotence, one event per successful administration, unchanged balances/supply/rates and regrant restoration are included.
R5-REVOKE.wrappers: New Finset capability administration and trusted admin mapping. Native Typed.Authority capability IDs/tombstones are not executed or refined by these theorems.

R6-ATOMIC.domain: Every valid state and every four-element raw call list in the R4 domain, including staged grants, revokes, issuance and burns.
R6-ATOMIC.claims: atomicRaw stages the exact runRaw result. Complete success returns the identical state with four ordered events. Any refusal returns its same reason/index, committed count zero, and exact complete entry PublicState, restoring balances, derived supply, rates, capabilities and history.
R6-ATOMIC.wrappers: New abstract commit/rollback wrapper; native Atomic.runAtomic and its grouped-event semantics are not measured.

R7-NET.domain: Every valid state and four independent same-request-actor transfer records, all account/asset aliases and self-transfers. Raw validation and aggregate theorems quantify arbitrary-length raw lists, including invalid request actors, unsupported records, invalid/mismatched targets, malformed numbers and signed amounts.
R7-NET.claims: Canonical includes exact signed aggregate, raw success iff an independent RawMatches-based domain, ordered first invalid record refusal, invoke plus exactly negative aggregate debit authority, final-cell nonnegativity funds domain, native settlement success and exact NetClaims. Sequential success iff GrossAuthority and input-derived PrefixFunds implies net success and equal balances/supply/rates/capabilities. Histories remain one net versus four sequential events; net success need not imply sequential success.
R7-NET.wrappers: New validation, sum-of-native-move aggregate, event and sequential-correspondence wrappers. Financial settlement invokes native Core.execute; authority uses native DebitAuthorized on aggregate effects.

R8-REUSE.domain: Every valid state, actor and four independent signed rational amounts for vault B/shareB. Both vault rates remain independent arbitrary positive rational inputs; the A cells and shares are framed.
R8-REUSE.claims: The entire ComposeCanonical true 4 contract, including complete success/refusal behavior, local composition, receipts, all prefixes, frame and B surplus. ReuseAssisted imports the checked R3N4 foundation and actually applies generic_compose true 4; it adds no financial model or copied proof.
R8-REUSE.wrappers: Second instance of the already parameterized adapted contract. Reused generic theorem was checked before extension authoring; its selected application is AI proof assistance.

limitations: Abstract state/effect proofs only; no claim about deployed programs, signatures, dishonest administrator resistance or distributed atomicity.
Fixed-rate accounting surplus preservation is not changing-price economic solvency; negative entry surplus remains in scope.
Raw malformed-number tags model validation outcomes without proving an external serialization implementation.
Source/proof correspondence and preparation checks do not replace executed acceptance, reconstruction, separate-context admission or scored replay.
